title: Representation technique as a generic list join (rep-join, abscissa filter density 1/4): signed m-list MITM at m = 2..9
hypothesis: The representation filter (pair sums and probes kept only when the abscissa hash lies in a 2^-2 subset) does not lower counted S against the MITM baseline at any m: generically it saves table memory and lookups but every (m-2)-tuple is still enumerated, so additions per relation rise by about 2^d once the m-sums cover the group. Falsified by a phase-1 PASS at any m.
